title: Mega Man X7
subtitle: PlayStation 2 · X / Axl / Zero
intro: Follow the weapon chain with Axl and Zero, rescue 64 Reploids to recruit X, then return for Glide Armor. Choose who receives each permanent upgrade before picking it up.

stages.name: Soldier Stonekong
stages.tip: Circle away from sword swings and rolling rocks. Shoot when his shield is out of the way; Zero can punish openings with short saber combos.

items.name: Heart Tank
items.text: Destroy the fifth large stone-head enemy along the forest path. The heart is underneath it.
items.when: First visit, or reserve the heart for X

items.name: EX Tank
items.text: At the final stone head, stand on top and let it rise. Double-jump toward the upper-left bushes for the EX item.

items.name: Glide · Leg Parts
items.text: Find two stone heads stacked together, with a Reploid behind them. Break the lower head, climb the upper one and enter the left alcove.
items.when: Return with X if he was not available

stages.name: Tornado Tonion
stages.tip: Keep moving around the arena during his spinning attacks. Use Gaea Shield near the exposed body after he sheds his sections.
stages.now: Check every rescue and hidden pickup

items.name: Heart Tank
items.text: At the large gap bridged by vanishing crates, stand on the second crate and let it disappear. Drop straight onto the heart’s platform rather than jumping past it.
items.when: First visit, or reserve the heart for X

stages.name: Splash Warfly
stages.tip: Use Volt Tornado when he lands. Keep away from the water’s edge and move out of his naginata sweep before attacking again.
stages.now: Check every rescue and hidden pickup

items.name: Sub Tank
items.text: In the second area, before the three serpent enemies, inspect behind the crate on the left.

items.name: Heart Tank
items.text: After those serpents, enter the next area and check behind the left-hand crate for the heart.
items.when: First visit, or reserve the heart for X

stages.name: Flame Hyenard
stages.tip: Shoot the giant mechaniloid’s legs to slow it, climb onto its back, and use Splash Laser against the real Hyenard. Move between attacks rather than standing inside the clone formation.

items.name: Heart Tank
items.text: In the platforming section of area two, find the first pipe venting green gas. Drop onto the pipe to collect the heart without falling into the lava.
items.when: First visit, or reserve the heart for X

items.name: Glide · Arm Parts
items.text: In the first area, reach the second giant serpent. Descend the nearby hole to the capsule below.
items.when: Return with X if he was not available

stages.name: Ride Boarski
stages.tip: Avoid the center when his rotating energy arms appear. Hit him with Circle Blaze after a rush, then steer clear of his next charge.
stages.now: Check every rescue and hidden pickup

items.name: Weapon Tank
items.text: Near the opening stacks of crates, clear the crates and follow the left side of the track to the tank.

items.name: Heart Tank
items.text: When pink lanes flank both sides of the road, keep to the right to collect the heart. Slow down enough to line up the pickup.
items.when: First visit, or reserve the heart for X

stages.name: Snipe Anteator
stages.tip: Use X or Axl for reliable ranged hits. Send Moving Wheel along the arena surface while dodging mines and missiles; reposition when gravity changes.

items.name: Heart Tank
items.text: At the start of area two, look left. Flip at the nearby orange platform, travel left along the underside, then use the next orange platform to reach the heart.
items.when: First visit, or reserve the heart for X

items.name: Glide · Head Parts
items.text: Near the end of area two, find the samurai walking through a wall between orange platforms. Flip at the first platform, head right upside down, then flip at the large orange platform beside the capsule.
items.when: Return with X if he was not available

stages.name: Wind Crowrang
stages.tip: Lock on with Sniper Missile while he is airborne. Watch his shadow and dash away before the dive lands; fire during the recovery.

items.name: Heart Tank
items.need: Collect before the red plane crashes
items.text: In the opening aircraft sequence, board the red plane and watch for the heart as it starts to crash. Collect it, then immediately jump to the next safe aircraft.
items.when: First visit, or reserve the heart for X

items.name: Glide · Body Parts
items.text: Inside the large ship in area two, reach the three-way junction. Take the left branch to the capsule.
items.when: Return with X if he was not available

stages.name: Vanishing Gungaroo
stages.tip: Break the Ride Armor, then use Wind Cutter against Gungaroo. Keep your distance during his punching rush and jump clear of shockwaves.
stages.now: Check every rescue and hidden pickup

items.name: Heart Tank
items.text: In the last room with the Ride Armor kill counter, climb the tall pillars and take the heart from its pillar before clearing the room.
items.when: First visit, or reserve the heart for X

items.name: Sub Tank
items.text: The Sub Tank is on a different pillar in the final Ride Armor room. Collect both rewards before the last enemy falls and the boss battle starts.

extraSections:
Recruit X

Rescue 64 Reploids and return to headquarters. X becomes available for the next stage selection. Clearing all eight Mavericks also unlocks him, even if the rescue total is lower.

Four perfect 16-rescue stages reach 64; missed or dead hostages delay this. Check the actual total. Once X joins, revisit Stonekong for the glide move and Hyenard for charged special weapons. The main route does not require avoiding rescues to optimize X’s stats.

Upgrade ownership & chip choices

Assign before collecting: loose hearts and rescued Life/Weapon Ups go to the active hunter. Boss stat rewards go to the finishing hunter. Power-Up Chips are allocated afterward to one of the two hunters on that stage.

Each hunter has Power, Speed and Special trees, four purchases each. Only 16 chips are available per run, versus 36 purchases across all three hunters. Focus on your main pair.

Suggested first purchases: Power toward Shock Absorber for durability, and Special’s first Super Recover upgrade for stronger healing. X’s final Speed upgrade is Hyper Charge; Zero’s Speed tree adds saber combo attacks. This is a practical recommendation, not a required route.

Rescue sweep

Every main stage has 16 Reploids. Enemies and stage hazards can kill them; back up your save before entering. Confirm SAFE status before committing the result.

  • Forest: rescue near stone enemies before provoking their attacks; use Axl’s copy abilities for otherwise blocked paths.
  • Radio Tower: check the maze and vanishing platforms. Do not leave exposed hostages beside active enemies.
  • Battleship / Lava Factory: look behind crates and around side platforms; hurry to anyone threatened by lasers or fire.
  • Central Circuit: steer deliberately through the timed bomb course. A fast clear alone does not ensure every rescue.
  • Cyber Field: bring Axl for samurai-copy passages and inspect both sides of gravity platforms.
  • Air Forces: check wings and side paths before advancing past timed aircraft sections.
  • Tunnel Base: search pillars and side areas before the final kill-counter enemy triggers the boss.

Use the name-by-name Solid_Rambo rescue reference to match missing roster entries. Target 128 SAFE, including all chip carriers.

Zero’s weapon chain

BossUseYou learn
StonekongSaber first; Hadangeki in rematchGokumonken · hold Attack standing still
TonionGokumonken counterRaijinshou · Special while dashing
WarflyRaijinshouD-Glaive + Suiretsusen · Special with glaive
HyenardSuiretsusenBakuenjin · Giga Attack
BoarskiBakuenjin; saber if emptyZankourin · Special while walking
AnteatorZankourin; ranged partner recommendedHieijin · Special in air
CrowrangHieijinV-Hanger + Souenbu · Special with daggers
GungarooSouenbuHadangeki · Special standing still

Use mapped actions, not assumed controller buttons. Bakuenjin consumes Giga energy. Weapon choice changes which technique is available.

Useful tips

  • After X has the Arm Parts, charge Volt Tornado and bring its field into enemies to generate health refills. Collect with the hunter who needs healing, then top up tank reserves. This is a built-in weapon effect.
  • Super Recover improves refill pickups. Revisit a cleared stage for health before the final palace.
  • Use Axl’s hover to judge difficult gaps. Stop firing briefly if it makes movement harder to control.
  • Switch hunters before a life bar empties. Reposition the camera and verify the lock-on target before firing near dangerous edges.
  • In Gungaroo, Ride Armor protects against the green acid. Leave it only on safe ground, and collect the pillar rewards before clearing the room.

Crimson Palace & final bosses

FightDo this
Palace Road mechaniloidUse ranged fire and Explosion when its weak point is accessible; dodge the crushing approach.
RedStay on safe platforms, track the real Red, and use Explosion / Hadangeki when in range. Movement matters more than chasing every opening.
Eight rematchesReuse the weapon chain and gather refills between fights.
SigmaUse charged X-Buster from cover. Crouch behind blocks during the large beam.
Final SigmaShoot the head when exposed; move between safe platforms to avoid sweeps and knockback. Save tanks for mistakes late in the fight.

New Game+ & endings

Save clear data in a separate slot. New Game+ retains chip upgrades and completed Glide Armor, and makes X available after the opening. Hearts, Life/Weapon Ups and tanks reset, so collect them again. Reploids can award another set of chips.

Choose the final active hunter deliberately for the character ending. Keep a pre-final save if you want to replay with another hunter. There is no capsule quest for Black Zero or Ultimate Armor in standard X7.

warning.text: The active hunter receives hearts and rescued Life/Weapon Ups. The hunter who lands the final boss hit receives that boss’s stat boosts. Dead Reploids lose their rewards for this run. Save separately before each stage. X joins after 64 rescues or all eight boss clears; prioritize rescues to get him sooner.

routeIntro: Standard gameplay, without Improvement Project changes. The route starts Stonekong with basic attacks, then uses each reward against the next boss. Rescue every reachable Reploid; X is not guaranteed to unlock exactly after boss 4 unless you have 64 rescues.

routes.name: Standard · weapon chain and Glide
routes.subtitle: Recommended first run
routes.description: Build Axl or Zero early, then bring X as soon as he joins.

steps.title: Stonekong → Tonion → Warfly → Hyenard
steps.text: Start Axl + Zero. Collect the shared tanks, use Zero for Stonekong’s high EX item, and save every Reploid. Decide whether to take early hearts now or leave them for X.

steps.title: At 64 rescues: recruit X
steps.text: Return to headquarters and confirm X is selectable. Pair X with Axl for copy routes or Zero for double-jumps.

steps.title: Return for Glide Legs and Arms
steps.text: Revisit Stonekong and Hyenard with X active at each capsule. Each piece works immediately; there is no four-program activation requirement.

steps.title: Boarski → Anteator → Crowrang → Gungaroo
steps.text: Finish the chain. Take X to Anteator and Crowrang for the remaining capsules. If X joined late, make those returns afterward.

steps.title: Final cleanup before the palace
steps.text: Collect any hearts reserved for X, verify four armor pieces, and fill both Sub Tanks and the Weapon Tank.

routes.name: Completionist · rescues and chip planning
routes.subtitle: 128 rescues · 16 chips this run
routes.description: One run collects everything on the map; maxing all three chip trees requires New Game+.

steps.title: Choose an early main hunter
steps.text: Put early boss and rescue stat rewards on Axl or Zero consistently. Save loose hearts for X if he will become your main. Do not leave endangered Reploids behind just to reserve their upgrades.

steps.title: Rescue 64 before investing in X
steps.text: Explore and replay stages as necessary. X cannot receive early chip allocations while unavailable; the guide does not promise every upgrade can go to X.

steps.title: Sweep every stage to 16 SAFE
steps.text: Watch for hostages behind crates, above the path, in copy-only passages and around timed bomb routes. Reload a clean save after a death.

steps.title: Find all 16 large pickups
steps.text: Use the same cards and grouped returns. In Gungaroo, collect both pillar rewards before defeating the final Ride Armor enemy.

steps.title: Save clear data separately
steps.text: Continue into New Game+ for more chips. Chip upgrades carry over, but hearts and tanks must be collected again.

flowIntro: X/Axl weapons form the loop shown below. Zero’s matching techniques are listed under each boss in the combat table. Stonekong starts with basic fire or saber; Explosion closes the loop in the rematch.
basicsHtml:
Tagging, rescues and armor
  • Bring two hunters and switch with the mapped Change Character action. Their life bars are separate; do not wait until one is defeated to switch.
  • Axl’s Copy Shot must land the finishing blow on a compatible enemy to produce its DNA Core. Collect the core for the temporary form.
  • Only active X can open a Light Capsule. Glide pieces function immediately after collection.
  • Hearts and rescued Life/Weapon Ups go to the collector. Power-Up Chips are assigned on the results screen to a member of the current pair.
  • Review the rescue report before overwriting a good save. Use stage exit on cleared levels; on uncleared levels, return to stage select after Game Over.

checkpoints.title: CHECK RESCUES · Is X available?
checkpoints.text: 64 rescues unlock X. Four boss clears alone do not.
checkpoints.stageText: Check the rescue total. If X is available, collect the earlier Glide pieces before continuing.

returnIntro: Bring X for every armor return. If you reserved a loose heart for him, keep X active when touching it. Use X + Zero for Stonekong’s EX item or X + Axl for copy-only rescue passages.
completionText: 8 loose hearts · 2 Sub Tanks · Weapon Tank · EX Tank · 4 Glide pieces. Completionist: 128 SAFE Reploids and 16 allocated chips; these are separate from the 16 large map pickups.

startHereHtml:
First time playing X7?

What to know before the route

X7 starts with Axl and Zero. Rescue 64 Reploids to recruit X early; otherwise he joins after all eight bosses. Bring two hunters and switch before the active hunter runs out of health.

Permanent upgrades are not all shared. Hearts and rescued stat increases go to the collector; the finishing hunter receives boss stat boosts. Save before each stage and review its rescue report before overwriting a good save.

Axl
Uses ranged weapons and temporary copied forms. Copy Shot must finish a compatible enemy to produce a DNA Core.
Zero
Fights at close range and learns techniques. His methods differ from the ranged weakness chain.
X and Glide Armor
Only active X opens capsules. Each Glide part works immediately after collection.
Rescues and chips
Dead Reploids lose their rewards for this run. Assign Power-Up Chips on the results screen.

Keep an undamaged save if you want every rescue. Maxing all three chip trees takes New Game+; one playthrough cannot do it.
